create_gaussians_optimizer: create a Gaussians object with Adam optimizers for means, scales, quats, opacities, and spherical harmonics parameters
render_3dgs_from_camera: render 3D Gaussian splats from a Camera object using gsplat rasterization with configurable anti-aliasing and radius clipping
render_2dgs_from_camera: render 2D Gaussian splats from a Camera object using gsplat rasterization_2dgs with distortion and normal outputs
extend_gaussians_from_color_points: extend the Gaussian set by adding new Gaussians from 3D points and RGB colors with configurable initial scale
save_gaussians_as_ply: save all Gaussian splat parameters including means, scales, rotations, opacities, and SH coefficients to a PLY file
